challenged_boundary: factory-valid independent GWT source event -> source-owned mediator authority -> trial-consumable semantic transport

source_observation.wire_construction_fact: IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt.to_wire emits a self-contained JSON envelope whose only transport integrity check is an unkeyed body_sha256 over caller-visible body fields.
source_observation.wire_consumption_fact: MediatedSemanticState.from_wire accepts raw bytes and validates envelope shape, unkeyed body digest, plan binding, canonical semantic JSON, frozen-oracle class and preregistered order, but it does not receive or validate a factory-sealed IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt, IndependentEventSourceRangeReceipt, factory-valid runtime witness, authenticated source capability, signature, MAC verified outside the trial trust boundary, or other non-forgeable source authority proof.
source_observation.provenance_fact: source_range_sha256, source_event_sequence, source_process_identity, runtime_witness_sha256, exact_source_sha256 and boot_id_sha256 are copied from the wire after syntactic/hash checks; their underlying source objects are not revalidated by from_wire.
source_observation.consequence: A downstream producer that knows the frozen plan and admissible canonical semantic value can synthesize a structurally valid wire, choose plausible provenance digests/identities, recompute body_sha256, and obtain a factory-sealed MediatedSemanticState without any actual independent source-range/runtime-witness event participating in that parse path.
source_observation.relation_to_existing_sidechannel_review: This is distinct from TRIAL_VISIBLE_WIRE_METADATA_SIDECHANNEL. Removing forbidden metadata from trial-visible bytes does not by itself establish that the remaining semantic transport was minted by the independent semantic source authority.

candidate_falsifier.hypothesis: The current G10 parser can mint a mediated semantic state from a counterfeit wire whose provenance fields were never factory-bound to an independent source event.
required_discriminator: Build a counterfeit G10 transport without calling IndependentSemanticMediatorReceipt.observe, IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder, GwtRuntimeWitnessRecorder or bind_reentry_to_uptake.
Use the frozen plan plus an admissible canonical semantic value, populate syntactically valid source/witness/provenance digests and identities, and recompute all unkeyed transport digests.
Attempt the canonical trial-side parse path. Current vulnerable behavior is acceptance; repaired behavior must fail closed before any behavior-capable semantic state is minted.
The repair must bind transport authenticity to an authority the behavior-capable trial cannot self-mint. A plain self-recomputed digest or caller-supplied provenance hash is insufficient.

Keep attestation/provenance verification on the independent verifier/readback path and keep the behavior-capable input condition-blind except for the canonical mediated semantic state required for the causal intervention.
Add regression coverage for both counterfeit-source provenance and the already-recorded trial-visible metadata sidechannel before freezing any VPS subject.
falsifying_outcomes: raw trial-visible bytes can be parsed into MediatedSemanticState without a non-forgeable source-authority proof
source_range/runtime-witness identities are accepted solely because their digest strings are well formed
an unkeyed digest over attacker-constructible fields is treated as source authenticity
the repaired API hides metadata but still lets the trial self-mint an equivalent authorized semantic state

counterhypothesis.statement: If an external process topology makes the raw parser unreachable to behavior-capable code and independently authenticates the source transport before calling it, the current parser could remain an internal decoder rather than an authority boundary.
counterhypothesis.required_proof: That trust boundary is not encoded by the current G10 repository API/tests. The repaired repository contract must either enforce authenticated source authority itself or make the parser explicitly downstream of an executable, independently tested verifier that behavior-capable code cannot bypass.

duplicate_authority_check: No successor generation, no second mediator authority and no runtime dispatch created. This delta supplements the existing G10 sidechannel review with an orthogonal source-authenticity falsifier and leaves the single active G10 mutation owner intact.
single_most_important_correction: Do not equate transport integrity with source authority: the trial-side path must be unable to self-mint a source-authorized semantic transport even if it can construct valid JSON and recompute every public digest.
